title: Arazzo 1.0.0 Released!

raw.title: Arazzo 1.0.0 Released!
raw.body:
The OAI is pleased to announce the official release of the Arazzo Specification 1.0.0!

## What's Changed
The initial stable version of the Arazzo specification, which is the cumulative work of the following items:
* Updating ReadMe with Charter, participants and getting involved details by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/6
* Proposal that we can submit to main OAI repo by @ndenny in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/1
* Splitting Champion from Contributors by @kinlane in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/11
* Create use-case-template.yml by @namdeirf in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/16
* Create CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md. by @namdeirf in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/15
* Rename CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md. to CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md by @namdeirf in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/18
* Delete CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md by @namdeirf in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/25
* Draft version minor enrichment by @kevin-postman in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/29
* Add coupon example by @shaisachs in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/32
* consistent quotes around cookie by @shaisachs in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/33
* Adding more examples and typo fixes by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/34
* Fix ReadMe typos by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/35
* link description update by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/37
* Update scope image and ReadMe clean up by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/38
* fix: mechanical changes only for ReSpec consumption by @MikeRalphson in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/39
* Create validate-markdown.yaml workflow by @MikeRalphson in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/40
* Merging main before reviewing other PRs by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/56
* Components proposal by @shaisachs in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/51
* Disambiguate workflows by @shaisachs in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/59
* Components Section for reusability by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/57
* Additional clarity on sourceDocument referencing. by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/63
* Add extension support to Success/ Failure Objects by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/68
* Frankkilcommins/issue66 by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/69
* Remove AsyncAPI support from initial draft by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/70
* Harden-expression-and-condition-capabilities by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/77
* Settle on "Workflows Description" by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/79
* fix use of workflow output in pet store example by @shaisachs in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/58
* Merge example changes to main by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/81
* docs: move Parameter Object spec extensions under the fields definition by @char0n in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/83
* chore: Tidy up object extension doc location by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/86
* chore: Add security and IANA considerations by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/88
* Typo by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/89
* Superfluous comma by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/90
* Monospace for `workflows` fixed field by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/92
* Simplify "Reference Objects `$ref` keywords" to "Reference Objects" by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/93
* Link to JSON Schema Validation by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/94
* Chore: Change Parameter.target to string by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/87
* Hyphen added by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/91
* Double-quotes around literal field values by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/102
* Section Criterion Object: links to sections where it can be used by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/103
* Monospace the double quotes of a literal string value by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/101
* operationRef matching referenced OpenAPI description by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/95
* chore: improve info.version description by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/98
* chore: remove ABNF rules related to AsyncAPI by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/110
* chore: force case insensitivity for string comparisons by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/111
* chore: enforce stepId to be must be within current workflow by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/112
* chore: resolve ToC issues by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/113
* Indicate specification is prerelease by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/120
* Move explanation regarding similar criteria for success/failure action objects to step by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/121
* Align FailureAction.Retry-After with the Retry-After response HTTP header by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/122
* Parameter Object: Revisit `in` verbiage remove `workflow` as option (infer instead) by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/123
* `workflowsSpec` MUST be used for interpretation by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/133
* Enforce Reference Object value overrides to avoid possible disregards by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/135
* clarify how to reference `operationId` and `workflowId` in case of clashes by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/125
* Better to explicitly state `stepId` must be mandatory within a workflow by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/134
* Component Object should be Components Object by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/136
* Fix the fragments for OAS 3.1 spec references by @handrews in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/146
* Update use of APImetrics name by @ndenny in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/141
* Swap inputs and parameters to match schema by @ndenny in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/142
* Fix target values to be valid JSON Pointers by @ndenny in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/143
* add `in` property to parameters by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/148
* Clarify Parameter target JSON Pointer by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/147
* Specification Path expressions for operations with no OperationI ID by @ndenny in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/144
* Added README to provide details on existing examples and provide addi… by @kevinduffey in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/151
* Chore: fix `pet-coupons.workflow.yaml` example by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/158
* feat: remove support for `dependsOn` for v1.0.0 by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/159
* chore: suggest multilevel parameters by @DmitryAnansky in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/155
* Remove references to WHATWG to avoid confusion by @ndenny in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/145
* Adjust Step Parameters desc to cater for Workflow parameters addition by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/169
* feat: add `dependsOn` capability for workflow level by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/164
* feat: Add Request Body Object by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/162
* Clarity on referencing Components Parameters by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/149
* feat: Reusable Success and Failure Actions by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/171
* chore: Remove `tbd` and update Worklfow `successActions` and `failureActions` to take advantage of Reusable Objects by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/174
* feat: Add support for XPath and versions of XPath and JSON Path for Criterion expressions by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/172
* Remove mutual exclusivity constraint between `payload` and `pointers`. Rename to `replacements` by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/183
* chore: fix example indentation by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/187
* Consolidate reusable parameters and reusable objects. by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/182
* update specification to take care of Arazzo (Tapestry) name change. by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/189
* feat: support for respec html generation by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/192
* Feat/revamp-readme by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/193
* chore: fix missing fixed field and table layout by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/197
* Link-fragments-in-html-conversions by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/199
* Link-fragments-in-html-conversions by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/201
* feat: Initial draft of BNPL Arazzo and OpenAPI documents by @SensibleWood in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/209
* Render OR (||) operator correctly in HTML by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/210
* Minor example updates from linter by @lornajane in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/215
* Update ReadMe images by @frankkilcommins in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/229
* Use latest version of ReSpec by @ralfhandl in https://github.com/OAI/Arazzo-Specification/pull/239
